meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询并交叉分析多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在研究中同时检索多个生物数据库进行交叉比对
copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把生物信息学任务写成 Python 代码,用 bioservices 库访问 40 多项在线服务(如 UniProt、KEGG、Reactome 等),完成蛋白质检索、通路分析、跨数据库 ID 映射等工作;REST/SOAP 请求和结果解析由库内部处理。
howto.when: 当用户需要在一个工作流里查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、Reactome),做跨数据库分析或标识符映射时触发;快速单库查询不适用,建议改用 gget。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes Python using bioservices to access 40+ bio services (UniProt, KEGG, Reactome, etc.). It handles protein retrieval, pathway analysis, and cross-database ID mapping; REST/SOAP requests and result parsing are done inside the library.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to query several biological databases (UniProt, KEGG, Reactome) in one workflow, or map IDs across services. Not intended for quick single-database lookups; use gget for those.
